observations: Actual full nine-panel sheet viewed before authoring. KP2 develops central brow tension; KP3-4 progressively narrow ordinary lids while brows incline downward toward the center and the lips press. KP5-6 have fully closed eyes and a small pressed/downturned line. KP7 softens brow and mouth tension with eyes still closed; KP8 reopens toward neutral, and KP9 returns neutral. The source does not show smiling eyes, a smile, an open mouth or sideways gaze.
left_right_convention: Brow names use screen sides. blink_R closes screen-left and blink_L closes screen-right. Positive screen-left and negative screen-right tilt oppose inward. All gaze and aversion channels remain zero.
approximation: Existing rigid brows translate down 5.5 source pixels and rotate +5.2/-5.2 degrees at peak. They cannot converge horizontally, deform or add true central furrows. blink_L=blink_R=1 uses ordinary lids with 36 source-pixel lash travel. Lip pressure .65 reuses existing pressed-lip owners. Tiny purse .05 shortens total contour width by 1.4 source pixels (.686 bust pixels); its center shifts down .2 and endpoints down .6 source pixels. This is a small symmetric purse contour approximation, not a genuine independent downturned corner. Mouth aperture stays zero. Reference fidelity and perceptual distinctness need native review.
approval: Accepted reference art does not approve this candidate or animation.
